faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test determines the susceptibility of the MTb complex to the drug Clofazimine.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • This test is primarily done to understand the drug susceptibility of the MTb complex specifically to clofazimine by assessing the growth patterns of MTb complex bacteria in response to this drug. • Additionally, it allows healthcare professionals to monitor drug resistance patterns and adjust treatment plans accordingly.

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended in the following circumstances: • Patients with confirmed or suspected tuberculosis infections to determine the most appropriate drug regimen • Individuals who have shown resistance or intolerance to other tuberculosis medications • Those requiring a change in their current medication due to treatment failure or recurrence of TB

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate resistance to Clofazimine, which could affect the choice of medication.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside this test include: • Drug susceptibility testing for other drugs used in tuberculosis treatment • Chest X-ray or CT scan to evaluate the extent of lung involvement • Acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear and culture tests to confirm the presence of mycobacteria and identify the specific strain

faqs.question: What is the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Clofazimine Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: Clofazimine Antibiogram for Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTb) complex using MGIT method

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by the Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria. It primarily affects the lungs, but can also impact other organs. TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Symptoms include persistent cough, weight loss, fever, and fatigue. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial to prevent complications and transmission.
